_comment: LOCAL REFERENCE RESOURCE template. A governed, cross-product source the team consults but does not sync as a repository: a design-system standard, an architecture catalog, a runbook library, a policy reference set. Save to records/resources/local/<slug>.json. Remove all _comment fields before saving.
_comment_admission: Admit only a governed source with its own status or freshness signal. A broad container ('the shared drive'), a work-in-progress lane, or an operational capability never qualifies — those cannot answer relianceCheck, and a reference source you cannot verify is folklore with a URL.
name: {{Human-readable name of the reference source}}
description: {{What this source is, in one or two sentences.}}
location: {{workspace-relative path or binding token — never an absolute machine path}}
consultationUse: {{The one class of question this source answers. If you cannot state it in a sentence, it is a container, not a reference source.}}
relianceCheck: {{How a reader confirms an artifact here is still safe to rely on: a status registry, a freshness date, a validation report.}}
